sentences: It is a wise father that knows his own child, but today a man can boost his paternal (fatherly) wisdom—or at least confirm that he's the kid's dad.
All he needs to do is shell out $30 for a paternity testing kit (PTK) at his local drugstore—and another $120 to get the results.
translations: 聪明的父亲才能认出自己的孩子，但如今男人可以提升自己做父亲的智慧——或者至少确认自己是孩子的父亲。
他只需在当地药店花30美元购买亲子鉴定工具包（PTK），再花120美元就能得到结果。

sentences: More than 60,000 people have purchased the PTKs since they first became available without prescriptions last year, according to Doug Fogg, chief operating officer of Identigene, which makes the over-the-counter kits.
More than two dozen companies sell DNA tests directly to the public, ranging in price from a few hundred dollars to more than $2,500.
translations: 据生产非处方试剂盒的Identigene公司首席运营官道格·福格称，自去年无需处方即可购买以来，已有超过6万人购买了PTK。
超过24家公司直接向公众出售DNA检测，价格从几百美元到2500多美元不等。

sentences: Among the most popular: paternity and kinship testing, which adopted children can use to find their biological relatives and families can use to track down kids put up for adoption.
DNA testing is also the latest rage among passionate genealogists—and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots.
translations: 其中最受欢迎的是亲子鉴定和亲属关系鉴定，被收养的孩子可以用它来寻找亲生亲属，家庭可以用它来追踪被送养的孩子。
DNA检测在热心的系谱学家中也风靡一时，并支持那些提供寻找家族地理根源服务的商业机构。

sentences: Most tests require collecting cells by swabbing saliva in the mouth and sending it to the company for testing.
All tests require a potential candidate with whom to compare DNA.
translations: 大多数检测需要用棉签从口腔中采集唾液细胞，并将其送到公司进行检测。
所有检测都需要一个潜在的比对对象来比较DNA。

sentences: But some observers are skeptical.
"There's a kind of false precision being hawked by people claiming they are doing ancestry testing," says Troy Duster, a New York University sociologist.
He notes that each individual has many ancestors—numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back.
Yet most ancestry testing only considers a single lineage, either the Y chromosome inherited through men in a father's line or mitochondrial DNA, which is passed down only from mothers.

This DNA can reveal genetic information about only one or two ancestors, even though, for example, just three generations back people also have six other great-grandparents or, four generations back, 14 other great-great-grandparents.
translations: 但一些观察家持怀疑态度。
纽约大学社会学家特洛伊·达斯特说：“那些声称在做祖先检测的人兜售的是一种虚假的精确性。”
他指出，每个人都有许多祖先——仅几个世纪前就有数百位。
然而，大多数祖先检测只考虑单一血统，要么是通过男性父亲系遗传的Y染色体，要么是仅由母亲传递的线粒体DNA。
这种DNA只能揭示一两个祖先的遗传信息，尽管例如仅三代之前，人们还有六位其他曾祖父母，或者四代之前，有十四位其他高祖父母。

sentences: Critics also argue that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections to which a sample is compared.
Databases used by some companies don't rely on data collected systematically but rather lump together information from different research projects.
This means that a DNA database may have a lot of data from some regions and not others, so a person's test results may differ depending on the company that processes the results.
In addition, the computer programs a company uses to estimate relationships may be patented and not subject to peer review or outside evaluation.
translations: 批评者还认为，商业基因检测的准确性取决于用于比对样本的参考数据库。
一些公司使用的数据库并非依赖系统收集的数据，而是将不同研究项目的信息混在一起。
这意味着DNA数据库可能包含某些地区的大量数据而缺少其他地区的数据，因此一个人的检测结果可能因处理结果的公司不同而有所差异。
此外，公司用于评估亲属关系的计算机程序可能已获专利，不受同行评审或外部评估的约束。
